answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A nectar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the anchor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
